producer: Jiyong Sung / AI-assisted task_x GPU pipeline
limitation: Does not satisfy taskboard requirement for another human team member sign-off.
method: Independent NumPy source readers; PROJ spherical destinations and ECEF subtraction; CPU full rays; independent hourly loop; no producer imports.
attribution: Reader and PROJ/ECEF reference adapted from standalone pipeline/task_b_full_check.py; no module import.
darkness_criterion: Report difference in hours; no specified threshold.
random_method: Python random.Random(seed); sample(range(1681),5), in SITE_IDS order

checks: observer-centred 150 km gate, longitude wrapping, window and NaN fallback
full 720x4001 rays against analytic sphere curvature
hourly fractions and clipped longest dark run

metadata.grid: pixel centres; rows north->south; lon_unwrapped monotonic (deg E, may exceed 0..360); lon = same in -180..180
metadata.data_is_real: heights are real NASA PDS SLDEM2015 data; site coordinates may be mock
